About TRA

 At Tax Relief Advocates (TRA) , we are dedicated to serving our clients and community with integrity , empathy , and a client-first approach. Our vibrant, energetic culture balances hard work with a passion for making a meaningful impact nationwide. Our mission is to guide individuals through the tax resolution process with trust , education , and care , delivering solutions that transform lives.

  

 About the Role

 Are you ready to lead a marketing transformation through quality assurance and automation? As the Junior AI Data Engineer (Marketing), you’ll be the driving force behind ensuring the quality and performance of our AI-driven marketing systems. This role builds the data and automation backbone for TRA’s marketing operations — replacing manual Google Sheet processes, automating data cleaning, and enabling real-time reporting across all campaigns. This role ensures that marketing, analytics, and operations teams have accurate, unified, and AI-ready data from all sources (radio, digital ads, affiliates, CRM, etc.).

  

 What You'll Do

 Build and maintain the unified database 

 
 Develop ETL/ELT pipelines pulling from internal systems and third-party APIs into a centralized warehouse

 Write and optimize SQL for transformations and reporting layers

 Model data so it's consistent and documented across sources

 
 API integration 

 
 Build and test integrations against REST APIs

 Handle authentication, pagination, rate limits, and error handling

 Write tests that catch failures early

 
 Data quality ownership 

 
 Build validation and monitoring to catch missing, duplicate, corrupted, or inconsistent records before they reach a dashboard

 Investigate discrepancies and reconcile against source systems

 Establish reusable automated checks

 
 Deployment and automation 

 
 Set up and maintain CI/CD pipelines

 Deploy and monitor scheduled jobs on cloud infrastructure

 Maintain clean version control and participate in code review

 
 Testing and code quality 

 
 Write unit and integration tests for pipelines, integrations, and internal services

 Maintain and grow test coverage as the codebase expands

 Participate in code review and help keep engineering standards consistent across the team

 
  

 What You Bring

 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related technical field

 1+ year of hands-on experience (internships and substantial project work count)

 Proficiency in Python and SQL

 Experience calling, testing, and debugging REST APIs

 Working knowledge of Git

 Working familiarity with AWS and/or Azure

 Understanding of CI/CD and automated deployment

 Strong technical reading comprehension and attention to detail

 
 Nice to have

 PostgreSQL, Supabase, Power BI, FastAPI, Docker, dbt/Airflow, or experience working with LLM APIs. Don't have all of these? No problem — we're happy to help you grow into them.

  

 Why Join Us?

 At TRA, you’ll join a high-impact, forward-thinking team revolutionizing tax resolution through innovative AI and automation. You’ll tackle exciting QA challenges, collaborate with top talent, and play a central role in ensuring client-first solutions at scale. We’re not just building smarter systems -- we’re creating a better experience for every person who turns to us for help. Join us to lead TRA’s AI-driven QA automation strategy and shape the future of how we grow, connect, and serve.

  

 Location: Irvine, CA - onsite

 Compensation: Up to $85,000 - $110,000 depending on experience 

 Position Type: Full-time, permanent  

  
 We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value diversity and encourage all qualified individuals to apply.
